MLX-9000 Series Canbus/ Databus models



The MLX-9000 Series is the latest generation of Dakota Digital popular bar-mount instrument system.  Loaded with features and ability to customize to your liking, choose from your preference of a Databus version to plug into most ’04-13 Harley Davidson models, or the Canbus version with compatibility with select 2014-2024 Harley Davidson models!  Integrated pushbutton switches allow for accessible operation, even with gloves.

User-selectable RGB Lighting allows color selections to suit your bike and theme, movable displays allow you to place readouts in a variety of display locations, or even a selection between a digital or bar-graph style of readout for several displays!  Furthermore, you can select between the oval or spike shaped units, along with an option of a Chrome or Black housing.  If you’ll be using this outside of the USA, you can also select between Imperial or Metric displays!

The MLX-9000 Series allows for further display expansion as well, including Air Suspension Pressure readouts, Boost Pressure or even a GPS-powered Compass.  The MBM Series of Expansion Models allow this to take place with ease!

Dimensions:
MLX-9204 and MLX-9214:  6.5" x 2"
MLX-9404 and MLX-9414: 5-7/8" x 2"

Standard readouts include:
Speedometer
Tachometer
Odometer
Trip Odometer A & B
Service Meter
Hourmeter
Oil Temp (when sensor is purchased separately)
Oil Pressure (when sensor is purchased separately)
Voltmeter
Gear Position
Clock
Fuel Level (when utilizing tank-mounted sensor)

Indicator lamps available:
Left & Right turn signal
Check Engine
Low Oil
Security
High Beam
Neutral

Performance readouts:
High Speed Recall
High RPM Recall
0-60 Time
Quarter mile time and speed

* Not compatible with V-Rod applications.
** Do to varying OEM connectors, the MLX-9214 and MLX-9414 will not plug directly into the stock 2018 and newer Breakout, Softail standard, Streetbob and Lowrider ST gauge harness.
